reason: My statin already handles my cholesterol, and I don't stress about restaurants. I'd try the free first scan out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay $39.99 a year for something I can mostly get by asking ChatGPT with a photo of the menu.
objection: Why pay for a narrow app when a general AI assistant can already look at a photo of the menu and tell me what's fried or creamy for free?
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor told me my numbers were still high despite the statin and I needed to change how I eat out, and the app's ratings matched what my doctor and dietitian would say.
